title: Void Pixelmon
description: A modpack designed for playing on the VoidPixelmon server, focusing on the Pixelmon mod. The modpack is quite basic, but I plan to implement more mandatory mods in the future.
body:
Brazilian Pixelmon Server

Void Pixelmon

Void Pixelmon is a server with various mechanics focused on the Pixelmon mod and Survival mode.

Server Features:

- Survival
- Open World
- Keep Inventory
- Claims System to protect your base
- RTP (Random Teleport)
- Mission System
- Story Mode
- Kits
- Gym Leaders
- Economy based on Farming, Mining, and defeating Pokémon
- Boxes with Legendary, Paradox, Shiny, and various items
- Special items related to Pixelmon
- Items with textures
- Tag System
- Redesigned Breed system to be simpler
- GTS (Auction)
- Battle Tower (With its own economy and rotating shop)
- Voting System
- Unique Clan System
- Pokémon with custom textures

Events:
- Daily events based on Pokémon
- Automatic events
- Weekly Tournament

discord: https://discord.gg/mYPfMnQXzd

This is the official modpack for the Void Pixelmon server.
